exposure: Type of birth attendant (physician, midwife, associate nurse)
cohort: 2025 mothers who delivered at Nakfa Hospital in Eritrea between 2020 and 2022
finding: A significant proportion of mothers had inadequate postpartum stays after vaginal delivery, highlighting the need for improved antenatal care, training for birth attendants, and further research on factors influencing length of stay.
mod_finding: Postpartum length of stay was significantly shorter after vaginal delivery compared to cesarean delivery.
